description: Default model/provider choices for UI verifier LLM roles. Override with UI_VERIFIER_MODEL_CONFIG or role-specific environment variables documented in docs/model_configuration.md.

claim_decomposition.rationale: Text-only structured decomposition benefits from low cost and deterministic behavior.

pipeline_claim_fallback.rationale: Cheap text-only structured decomposition fallback for evaluation runs.

evidence_retrieval.rationale: Cheap text-only reranking over extracted screen text before multimodal verification.

verification.rationale: Screenshot-grounded verification is the highest-risk multimodal step and should use the stronger Flash model.

demo_image_verifier.rationale: Demo verifier is budget-capped and falls back deterministically.

requirement_harvest.rationale: Flow-level requirement harvesting sees multiple screenshots and should prioritize recall and grounding.

api_requirement_harvest.rationale: Interactive harvesting keeps the previous more exploratory API default.

candidate_rewrite.rationale: Candidate normalization is text-only and schema constrained.

claim_rephrase.rationale: Single-claim editing is low-risk and should be inexpensive.

contrastive_generation.rationale: Manual contrastive generation records the external/manual model label for provenance.
